node.title: hankel sparse atoms as rational defects
node.statement: Sparse annihilator atoms of a Hankel state are small defect sets of rational approximants to the spectral weight (RS-dual normal form); distinct-closure atoms satisfy |T1 u T2| >= j-t+2 (verified 233130 pairs, 0 violations); same-approximant atoms saturate to ONE closure (punctured-GRS/MDS collapse). Hereditary via the proved stability lemma.
